perlre: under /m `^` matches at the start of the string and after a newline -- but NOT after a newline that ends the string (perl's MBOL never matches at the very end).  cl-ppcre's multi-line start anchor matches after every newline, the last one included.

FIX SHAPE (to be measured): PCL's translation of `^` under /m (perl-regex-to-ppcre / the (?m) paths, split's /^/ -> /^/m rule included) to "`^` and not at the end of a non-empty string" -- in PCL's wrapper, never in the vendored cl-ppcre.  Check `split /^/, "a
b
"` (2 fields in perl), m//g pos() and a string with no trailing newline before shipping.


=== DONE (s513f) ===
In PCL's scanner wrapper (%pcl-mbol-tree / %pcl-mbol-node, never the vendored engine): a `^` running in multi-line mode becomes (?:\A|^(?!\z)) in the parse tree, the mode tracked through (?m) flags and (?m:) groups; a pattern with no such `^` is compiled untouched. Probed counts, s///mg, split /^/ and /^/m, pos, /a
^/m, /^\z/m vs perl. Guard Pl/t/misc-fixes-03.t rows 1-2 (fail on main).
